subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembers that Stone Giants are not to be rushed into a conversation.
source_quote: Thorin remembers that Stone Giants are not one to be rushed into a conversation.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam sighs and says, 'Something evil stirs in the Underdark. The rock itself cries in pain and horror, and a madness creeps from the blackest depths.'
source_quote: The giant sighs, 'Something evil stirs in the Underdark. The rock itself cries in pain and horror, and a madness creeps from the blackest depths.'

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam is cryptic in the best of times.
source_quote: Stone Giants are cryptic in the best of times.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam raises an eyebrow at Thorin.
source_quote: The giant stares at him. And then raises an eyebrow.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam offers Thorin the stonespeaker crystal as a gift.
source_quote: Before I go, I have a gift." His assistant brings a 19 inch shard of quartz crystal.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam is attuned to the stones and speaks their wisdom.
source_quote: This is what the stones tell me.

subject: Shal
fact: Shal is the Deep King’s new advisor, but Hgraam has never met them.
source_quote: I have asked to meet Shal, but they refuse.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir admires the stone giants’ subtlety and patience.
source_quote: They speak little. They ponder and then they consider their words.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices the stark contrast between the clean Duergar dwellings and the cluttered Derro slums.
source_quote: The contrast with the clean, perfect Duergar dwellings is obvious.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observes Droki’s unnaturally fast pace and lack of concern for being followed.
source_quote: Droki also doesn’t seem to care if anyone is following him.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum sees Droki reveal a narrow fissure behind scraps of cloth and canvas.
source_quote: Droki lifts the scrap of cloth, pushes the gray sheets of canvas to the side, revealing a narrow fissure in the chasm wall.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido screams about the Council of Savants who promised freedom and failed to deliver it.
source_quote: He screams about the Council of Savants who promised freedom and failed to deliver freedom.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido believes he is on a divine mission to save his people.
source_quote: The divine mission requires that I go back! I must go and save them!

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds Buppido building a shrine of bones and skeletons in a cavern.
source_quote: I didn’t expect you to find me here, with my shrine nearly finished!

subject: Daz
fact: Daz casts Fairie Fire on three of Buppido’s skeletons.
source_quote: Daz casts Fairie Fire. Suddenly, three skeletons are marked, and an ethereal glow surrounds them.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir plunges the cavern into darkness to disrupt the skeletons.
source_quote: Zalthir, never one to shy away from unusual tactics, plunges the area into darkness.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum prepares to turn undead but waits for the darkness to shift.
source_quote: Grygum, ready with his holy symbol, prepares to turn undead. Daz understands the intent—to disrupt the skeletons and disorient Buppido.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin draws his sword as Buppido becomes a direct threat.
source_quote: Thorin has his sword drawn.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido claims his faithful are finally honoring him and offers truth to Daz.
source_quote: My faithful are finally honoring me! Are you …? Yes. Yes, I sense that you are ready to receive my truth into your hearts!

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observes that Droki’s path is well-worn and marked with junk the Derro drops.
source_quote: Droki's path is very well worn and marked with junk that the Derro drops.

subject: Droki
fact: Droki is a courier trusted by all factions for safe passage through the Whorlstone Caverns.
source_quote: Droki can be trusted to deliver messages to the groups in the Whorlstone caverns and keep secrets.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notices the stench in the Derro slums changes from acrid and metallic to fetid and repugnant.
source_quote: As he passes through the gates, the stench in the air changes from acrid and metallic to fetid and repugnant.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum sees the Derro homes are crudely carved from the rock or holes in the walls, arranged in no apparent order.
source_quote: The homes in this part of Gracklstugh are crudely carved from the rock or are just holes in the walls, arranged in no apparent order.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observes the floor of the cavern is carpeted with humanoid remains arranged in a spiral pattern.
source_quote: The floor is carpeted with humanoid remains in varying stages of decomposition, arranged in a spiral pattern around the cave’s center.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says, 'The divine plan tells me I must help you!'
source_quote: Buppido smiles, 'The divine plan tells me I must help you!'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin whispers, 'If you betray us, I will gut you.'
source_quote: Thorin whispers, 'If you betray us, I will gut you.'

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam says, 'The Deep King has tried to keep order and control, and the more he tries, the more the order escapes and tries to take the city from him.'
source_quote: The Deep King has tried to keep order and control, and the more he trie,s the more the order escapes and tries to take the city from him.

subject: The Faerzress
fact: Thorin wonders if the Faerzress affects his sanity and is connected to the spreading madness.
source_quote: Thorin wonders if this has anything to do with the Faerzress, which has affects his sanity.

subject: The Grey Ghosts
fact: The Deep King has become paranoid since Shal became his advisor, and his former calmness is gone.
source_quote: He and I would watch the stones grow. But something has happened to him. He has become paranoid towards old and new friends.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'What we have seen as localized appearances of demons is not localized.'
source_quote: So what we have seen as localized appearances of demons is not localized.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes that the widespread presence of demons is enabled by powerful magic.
source_quote: There is some kind of powerful magic that has enabled this.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam gives Thorin the stonespeaker crystal, which allows Speak with Animals, Speak with the Dead, and Speak with Plants.
source_quote: This is the stonespeaker crystal, with it you can cast Speak with Animals, Speak with the Dead, and Speak with Plants.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin learns from Hgraam that the best way to the Dreamlands is through the city of the Deep gnomes.
source_quote: Thorin learns from Hgraam that the best way to the Dreamlands is through the city of the Deep gnomes.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum sees Droki mutter a repetitive series of phrases: 'Droki is late! They will be so angry! Stupid, stupid, stupid!'
source_quote: Droki mutters a repetitive series of phrases at different volumes... 'Droki is late! They will be so angry! Stupid, stupid, stupid!'

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido leads the party to the abandoned Duergar guardhouses in the West Cleft.
source_quote: The duergar built a series of guardhouses to keep an eye on their derro slaves living in the West Cleft. These were abandoned...

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observes that the Derro slums are dangerous to anyone, and that is why non-Duergar are needed to navigate them.
source_quote: And now, why Errde Blackstaff and the Keeper of the Flames were so anxious to find a non-Duergar to come here is clear.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin understands that the Duergar would have to go through the Derro to reach the tunnels, triggering a bloodbath.
source_quote: Thorin also understands why they are underneath the city. To get to the tunnels, the Duergar would have to go through the Derro, and that would trigger a bloodbath.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observes the Derro slums are dirty and cluttered, with homes carved into walls and piled atop one another.
source_quote: The district's dirty and cluttered streets clearly formed as dwellings spread and came together, not as a product of planning.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam says, 'The Deep King creates so many enemies. He used to be so calm.'
source_quote: Grey Ghosts? The Deep King creates so many enemies. He used to be so calm.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum sees a wisp of eerie fog float out of the fissure after Droki enters.
source_quote: Just as he disappears into the cavern, a wisp of eerie fog floats out.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz hears an off-key humming from a hunched figure building a shrine of bones.
source_quote: An off-key humming comes from a hunched figure working busily at something on the floor.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin charges forward and lands a solid blow on one of Buppido’s skeletons.
source_quote: Thorin, eager as ever, wastes no time. The dwarf charges forward, closing with one of the skeletons.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido charges with a hooked spear, but misses wildly.
source_quote: Buppido rushes at Thorin with a hooked spear but misses wildly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is hit by a crossbow bolt from one of Buppido’s skeletons.
source_quote: One skeleton, however, manages to take a shot at Grygum with its crossbow. Daz sees Grygum flinch as the bolt hits.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir’s darkness disrupts the skeletons, causing some to blunder blindly.
source_quote: Confusion reigns for a moment. Some of the skeletons blunder blindly in the darkness, stumbling around aimlessly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum holds his action, waiting for the darkness to shift before turning undead.
source_quote: Grygum holding his action, waiting for the darkness to shift so that more skeletons are visible.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum’s words of power overwhelm Buppido’s skeletal minions.
source_quote: The cleric’s words of power overwhelm the skeletal minions of Buppido.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realized it was time to deal directly with Buppido and focused his arcane energy, feeling the familiar surge within him.
source_quote: He focuses his arcane energy, feeling the familiar surge within him.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thought 'Magic missiles' and visualized the shimmering darts before casting them.
source_quote: ‘Magic missiles,’ he thinks, visualizing the shimmering darts.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz stared at Buppido’s corpse and muttered, 'Your divine mission is now over.'
source_quote: Daz stares at Buppido’s corpse and mutters, 'Your divine mission is now over.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin muttered, 'He was a crazy one, but he was our crazy one,' with sadness.
source_quote: ‘He was a crazy one, but he was our crazy one,’ mutters a sad Thorin.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek’s ghostly head popped up and asked, 'He’s dead?'
source_quote: ‘He’s dead?’

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek’s ghostly head rolled into place and said, 'Wonderful!'
source_quote: ‘Wonderful!’

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek announced his name, 'Pelek, at your service if you will be at mine.'
source_quote: ‘Pelek, at your service if you will be at mine.’

subject: Pelek’s name
fact: Pelek’s name is of uncertain origin, possibly derived from an actor or an onomatopoeic sound, but its true meaning is unstated and unresolved.
source_quote: ‘My mother named me after an actor. And well, there was always this doubt about the origin of the name and my lineage...'

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek recalled his childhood was delightful except for the emotional turmoil tied to his name.
source_quote: I had a delightful childhood, except when it came to my name.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek explained that his father was jealous and there was an undercurrent of hurt and shame tied to his name.
source_quote: My father was always very jealous, and there was always an undercurrent of hurt and shame in my name and how it affected my parents.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek became a merchant because of the emotional fallout from his name and his relationship with Buppido.
source_quote: I suppose that’s why I ended up as a merchant, and became friends with Buppido and ignored the tell-tale signs of his incipient murderous rampage.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek said Buppido killed him and cut his body into pieces he now sees.
source_quote: He killed me and cut my body up into the pieces you see here.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek was a supplier for Buppido, who worked with the Council of Savants to move product past Duergar taxes.
source_quote: He was working with a faction of Derro known as the Council of Savants. Buppido said he could move product out of the city without dealing with the Duergar taxes.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek noticed the Faerzress glowed brightly and then went dark before returning brighter than before.
source_quote: I did notice that the Faerzress glowed brightly, and after that, Buppido’s temperament changed... It was almost as if it was being sucked out, and went dark and then came back brighter than before.

subject: The Faerzress
fact: The nature of the Faerzress is unknown, and whether its blink broke plane barriers is an unresolved mystery.
source_quote: No one knows what the Faerzress is. And so I assumed it was something that happens.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum wondered aloud if the Faerzress’s blink could have broken the walls between the planes.
source_quote: Then if it blinked, could it have - I dunno - broken the walls between the planes?

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek dismissed the idea of plane-breaking as a ghost story.
source_quote: That sounds like a ghost story. The Faerzress blinked, and then monsters from the Abyss appeared.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek asked Grygum to collect his bones and bring them to Blingdenstone.
source_quote: These bones are my bones, and I would appreciate you folks collecting my bones and bringing them to Blingdenstone.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek mentioned a family ring on his hand, an obsidian ring of some value.
source_quote: There is a family ring on it, an obsidian ring of some value.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked if the ring was magical.
source_quote: Is the ring magical?

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek admitted the ring wasn’t magical but suggested he’d lie to encourage them.
source_quote: No. But if I said otherwise, would it encourage you more?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin growled, 'It wasn’t powerful enough to keep you alive.'
source_quote: It wasn’t powerful enough to keep you alive.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek shrugged and said he didn’t know how long he’d been there, but less than a year.
source_quote: Less than a year? Telling time in this cavern is hard.

subject: Droki
fact: Pelek knows Droki works for the Council of Savants and is peculiar, but nothing more is known about him.
source_quote: I was told that he works for the Council of Savants. He’s very peculiar.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt taken for granted and noted that Pelek had offered nothing in return for help.
source_quote: He’s confirmed that something weird has happened in the Underdark... But I knew that. And it’s not like he’s given us any useful information.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin shouted, 'Now listen here!' to Pelek.
source_quote: Now listen here!

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek laughed and said, 'Overbrighters.'
source_quote: Overbrighters.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek advised the party to deny association with Lolth, Menzoberranzan, and avoid references to the number eight or spiders in Blingdenstone.
source_quote: when you get there, make sure to deny any association to Lolth, or Menzoberranzan, and make any references to the number eight or spiders.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek said to avoid anything on their person that counts to eight.
source_quote: Just don’t have anything on your person that counts - obviously - to eight.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir stumbled, unable to remember the vague teachings of his monastic order after the ghost’s banter.
source_quote: he mutters and stumbles, unable to remember the appropriately vague and incomprehensible teaching of his monastic order

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realized the Derro ate mushrooms and saw a crack in the wall too small to fit through.
source_quote: The Derro ate some mushrooms. ... The crack is too small for anyone to fit into.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek looked into the crack and described a tiny tunnel, then noticed Pygmywort and Bigwig.
source_quote: A tiny tunnel. Tiny all the way through. Oh, look at that Pygmywort and Bigwig.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek identified Pygmywort as a mushroom with a one-inch stem and blue cap with white dots that shrinks like a reduce spell.
source_quote: Pygmywort is the mushroom with a one-inch-long stem and a stubby blue cap with white dots, and Bigwig is the four-inch-tall mushroom with a thin stem and a wide purple cap. The first one shrinks you, like the effect of a reduce spell, and the latter grows you, like the effect of an enlarge spell.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum impulsively swallowed a Pygmywort and shrank.
source_quote: Grygum impulsively swallows a Pygmywort and shrinks.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thought, 'This place used to be where hippies hid out. Now it has become a den of vipers aimed at the mad Deepking.'
source_quote: This place used to be where hippies hid out. Now it has become a den of vipers aimed at the mad Deepking.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir said, 'We must be quiet. There are many enemies about.'
source_quote: We must be quiet. There are many enemies about.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz announced, 'It is my time!' and marched toward the lake.
source_quote: ‘It is my time!’ announces Daz.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz cast a spell that froze the black, heated water of the lake.
source_quote: He casts a spell with a flourish, and the water freezes.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz cast another block of ice and led the party across the lake.
source_quote: He then proceeds to cast another block of ice, and they jump from block to block, eventually landing on the other side of the lake.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz smiled after crossing the lake and waited for applause.
source_quote: As they land safely, he smiles. And he waits for polite applause.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin slapped Daz’s back in a friendly manner.
source_quote: Thorin slaps his back. A friendly slap on the back.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum kept saying, 'Wow!'
source_quote: Grygum can’t stop saying 'Wow!'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed a fungal thicket ahead with a hissing sound like whispering voices.
source_quote: a hissing sound begins to rise. It sounds like uncounted tiny voices whispering in tongues he doesn't understand.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin warned the party that some mushrooms may have psychedelic effects and suggested holding their breath.
source_quote: there are some kinds of mushrooms that may have a psychedelic effect so I would hold our breath.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek said the hissing was just wind through the fungal thicket and called them 'Overbrighters' contemptuously.
source_quote: There’s nothing psychedelic about that sound. It’s the normal effect of wind blowing through a fungal thicket. ... Overbrighters.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz picked up barrelstalk, bluecap, ripplebark, trillimac, waterorb, and zurkwhood mushrooms.
source_quote: He picks up some barrelstalk, a large, cask-shaped fungus that stores water, bluecap for making flour, ripplebark that tastes good toasted, trillimac that can be used for scrolls and makes a bread-like substance that can be rolled up, waterorb for storing water, and zurkwhood for making things.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz recognized Nightlights as mushrooms that glow in a 15-foot circle and stop glowing when touched or cut.
source_quote: Nightlights—mushrooms that grow to 15 feet and shed light in a 15-foot-by-15-foot circle. When they are touched or cut, they stop glowing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz warned Thorin about the timmask, a two-foot-tall toadstool with orange and red stripes that causes madness if uprooted.
source_quote: Watch out," he shouts to Thorin. The dwarf was close to a two-foot-tall toadstool with orange and red stripes across its beige cap known as “the devil’s mushroom,” or a timmask. Uprooting the mushroom can cause madness.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz identified the torchstalk as a mushroom with a combustible cap that burns for 24 hours.
source_quote: Why, that’s a torchstalk. It has a combustible cap and can burn for 24 hours when lit.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz felt a shiver as swarms of centipedes emerged.
source_quote: Daz watches as the centipedes emerge, a shiver running down his spine.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz cast 'Toll the Dead' on the centipedes, but they saved.
source_quote: Toll the Dead," he mutters, focusing his magical energy. ... He watches intently as the spell is cast, but his hope quickly fades as the centipedes seem unfazed. 'They saved!'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz muttered under his breath, 'Seriously?' after 'Tasha's Caustic Brew' failed to affect the centipedes.
source_quote: Seriously?

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum cast 'Tasha's Caustic Brew' on the centipedes, but they avoided the brunt.
source_quote: Grygum then steps up, casting 'Tasha's Caustic Brew.' ... the centipedes somehow manage to avoid the brunt of the spell.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz perceives a glimmer of hope returning as Thorin strikes one of the swarms.
source_quote: Yes! There you go!" he thinks, a glimmer of hope returning

subject: Daz
fact: Daz muses that 'Burning Hands' might have been better than his current spell.
source_quote: Maybe 'Burning Hands' would have been better?" he muses

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wonders if his spells are ineffective or if he needs to re-strategize.
source_quote: he feels a slight unease, wondering if his spells are just ineffective or if he needs to re-strategize

subject: Daz
fact: Daz considers whether he needs a spell with a wider area of effect.
source_quote: or perhaps something with a wider area of effect

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds himself scanning his spell list and second-guessing his choices.
source_quote: Daz finds himself scanning his spell list, second-guessing his choices

subject: Daz
fact: Daz feels a slight unease about his spell effectiveness.
source_quote: He feels a slight unease, wondering if his spells are just ineffective or if he needs to re-strategize

subject: Daz
fact: Daz keeps scratching at his arms, feeling the phantom sensation of bugs.
source_quote: he keeps scratching at his arms, feeling the phantom sensation of bugs despite knowing there were none on him

subject: Daz's spell strategy
fact: Daz is uncertain whether his spells are ineffective or if he needs to re-strategize, and no resolution is provided in this session.
source_quote: He feels a slight unease, wondering if his spells are just ineffective or if he needs to re-strategize

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is plagued by a lingering sense of doubt about his spell choices.
source_quote: Daz finds himself scanning his spell list, second-guessing his choices
